content.title: On Semicondutor earnings, Coeur Mining & Eaton announce deals
content.description:
There are a number of stocks on the move on Monday, Nov. 3. On Semiconductor (ON) posted a Q3 earnings beat. Coeur Mining (CDE) is acquiring New Gold (NGD). Eaton (ETN) also announced a deal. It's buying Boyd Thermal for $9.5 billion.
